name: p2-round2-screen
budget_note: round-2 preregistered budget: 6 of the per-round 12 configs (round 1 used 9); directions derived from round-1 negative evidence, user approved round-2 scope 2026-09-17

data.price_convention: signals and event returns on adjusted levels close*adj_factor (suspension rows carry null factor -> null return, conservative); same-day pattern filters (gap, close-vs-open, range) use raw same-day prices which contain no intraday corporate action; pctChg/turn in percent

R2-volconfirm-reversal.hypothesis: 放量急跌（5日跌幅<-8% 且当日量>1.5×20日均量）释放卖压，次开进场的5日收益费用后优于同池基准
R2-volconfirm-reversal.from_round1: round 1 dropped the volume dimension; testing the volume-confirmed slice

R2-lowvol-dip.hypothesis: 低波动股的温和回调（20日波动率≤当日池中位 且 5日跌幅<-5%）会修复，费用后优于同池基准
R2-lowvol-dip.definition: volatility_20 <= daily eligible median AND ret_5_adj < -0.05
R2-lowvol-dip.from_round1: round-1 reversal losers were not volatility-stratified

R2-near52w-dip.hypothesis: 临近52周高点（≥250日最高调整收盘的90%）的当日回调股，5日收益费用后优于同池基准与追强
R2-near52w-dip.from_round1: 52w-high proximity is a distinct documented family vs round-1 20-day strength

R2-turnover-capitulation.hypothesis: 换手≥2×自身20日均值且当日跌>5%的恐慌抛售后有反弹，费用后优于同池基准
R2-turnover-capitulation.from_round1: turnover spike is an orthogonal conditioning variable

R2-gapdown-recovery.hypothesis: 跳空低开>2%但当日收阳的日内修复有次日延续，费用后优于同池基准
R2-gapdown-recovery.from_round1: intraday path information unused in round 1

R2-squeeze-breakout.hypothesis: 20日均振幅处于当日池低半区后出现>3%突破日，突破有延续，费用后优于同池基准
R2-squeeze-breakout.definition: range_mean_20 <= daily eligible median AND pctChg > 3.0
R2-squeeze-breakout.from_round1: compression-conditional breakout differs from unconditional chasing

execution.entry: next session open after signal close

fees.disclosure: stamp duty segments are institutional facts; commission segments are conservative assumed retail rates, NOT the user's actual fee (actual 万1 all-in, P3 scope); transfer fee ~0.001% omitted

validation.isolation: dev events must exit on or before 2020-12-31; validation events have signal_date >= 2021-01-01
validation.freeze: events whose hold crosses 2024-12-31 flagged horizon_out_of_range
validation.history_note: 2015-2024 inspected by the old project: rolling historical validation, never unseen-sample proof

dev_pass: mean net per completed event beats pool_equal_weight mean on dev
per-year net edge vs pool positive in >= 4 of 6 dev years
top-decile symbol share of total net profit <= 40%
validation_pass: mean net per completed event beats pool_equal_weight mean on validation
per-year net edge vs pool positive in >= 2 of 4 validation years
selection_rule.multiple_testing: 6 preregistered configs in round 2 (9 in round 1, 15 cumulative); survivors at most 2 proceed to P3; any post-hoc re-picking downgrades to exploratory

benchmarks.pool_equal_weight: per signal date, mean adjusted open-to-open return over all eligible symbols on identical calendar windows (no fees)
benchmarks.random_pick: 3 random eligible picks on every trading day through the identical event pipeline, seed 17

kill_criteria_note: mid/high slippage tiers are P3 scope; P2 runs tier-0 (no slippage) only
